column1: # The index of terms examples/typst-index.qmd prints in a Typst render (M098).
# Derived BY HAND from that source, under the ORACLE RULE at the head of
# tests/run-tests.sh, and never copied from a render. Read by
# tests/typstindex.py, whose `Line.row` states the row shape:
# A locator is its page, or first–last for a range; `*` marks a bold one, and
# `@N` the page its link goes to. A reference is word|target.
# The pages come from the source's explicit page breaks: page 1 runs to the
# first break, and each break starts the next page.
#   42nd Street  one mark, page 2; files under no letter
#   apple        three marks on page 1 and one on page 3: one locator a page
#   Bee          `entry="Bee"` on page 1; Hive nests under it on page 2
#   dahlia       ordinary then principal, both page 1: one bold locator
#   elm          a range opened and closed on page 1: that page alone
#   fig          a range opened on page 1 and closed on page 2; links to 1
#   The Hague    `sort="Hague"`, page 1: files under H
#   jam          `see-also="apple"` on page 2 and a plain mark on page 3
